genxml.title: Board description bytes the O2 kernel reads to choose GBE timing
genxml.from: shipped IRIX kernel binaries, per docs/gbe.md
genxml.doc: Software table, not a register map: the two bytes of the board description that select the interlace case and a flat-panel set-up, and the set-up values the timing routine recognises. The GBE registers they steer are described in the crime repository.
